Build the data_traits_measures row for a new measurement

dot-upd_ind_measure_row.Rd

The value goes where the feature wizard puts it: `traitvalue` for `numeric`, `integer` and `table_colnam` features, `traitvalue_char` for the others. The plot, taxon and specimen links are copied from the individual, as the wizard does.

Usage

.upd_ind_measure_row(
  individual,
  trait,
  value,
  id_sub_plots = NA_integer_,
  year = NA_integer_,
  month = NA_integer_,
  day = NA_integer_,
  issue = NA_character_,
  plot_name = NA_character_
)

Arguments

individual

One-row data frame of `data_individuals` (`id_n`, `id_table_liste_plots_n`, and `id_diconame_n`, `id_specimen` when present).

trait

One-row data frame of `traitlist` (`id_trait`, `valuetype`).

value

The value, as typed.

id_sub_plots

Integer(1) or `NA`. The census the value belongs to.

year, month, day

Integer(1) or `NA`. Measurement date, when it differs from the census's.

issue

Character(1) or `NA`.

plot_name

Character(1) or `NA`, kept as `original_plot_name`.

Value

A one-row data frame. Stops on an empty value, or on a value a numeric feature cannot hold.
